1. (Currently amended) A vehicle door comprising: a door outer panel defining an exterior surface of the vehicle door; a common door inner panel located inboard of the door outer panel and configured to mount door hardware, the common door inner panel having a periphery; and a panel extension extending around essentially all of the periphery of the common door inner panel, the panel extension being attached to the periphery of the common door inner panel, forming an inner panel-extension joint, and attached to the door outer panel via a hemmed joint, to secure the common door inner panel to the door outer panel, wherein the panel extension is __formed as a separate component prior to attachment to both the common door inner panel and the door outer panel__.

2. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 wherein the outer panel-extension joint is a hemmed joint [[formed by hemming the panel extension to the door outer panel]].

3. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 wherein the inner panel-extension joint includes __riveted__ fasteners securing the panel extension to the common door inner panel.

4. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 including at least one hinge that is mounted to the common door inner panel __via a frame member__.

5. (Currently amended) A vehicle door comprising: a door outer panel defining an exterior surface of the vehicle door; a common door inner panel located inboard of the door outer panel and configured to mount door hardware, the common door inner panel having a periphery; and a panel extension, configured to mate with the door outer panel, extending around essentially all of the periphery of the common door inner panel, the panel extension being __formed as a separate component and__ attached to the periphery of the common door inner panel and attached to the door outer panel to secure the common door inner panel to the door outer panel, wherein __the panel extension and door outer panel are replaceable as a unit independent of the common door inner panel__.

6. (Original) A method of assembling a vehicle door, the method comprising the steps of: (a) forming a panel extension separate from a common door inner panel and a door outer panel; (b) attaching the panel extension to the door outer panel; (c) mounting door hardware to the common door inner panel; and (d) attaching the panel extension to a periphery of the common door inner panel.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein step (b) is further defined by hemming the panel extension to the door outer panel __to form a hemmed joint__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein step (d) is further defined by attaching __riveted__ fasteners to the panel extension and the common door inner panel.

9. (Original) The method of claim 8 wherein step (d) is further defined by the fasteners being rivets, and the panel extension being riveted to the common door inner panel.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising: (e) forming a second panel extension separate from the common door inner panel and a second door outer panel, __wherein the second door outer panel is different from the door outer panel and the second panel extension is different from the panel extension__; (f) attaching the second panel extension to the second door outer panel; (g) mounting second door hardware to the common door inner panel; and (h) attaching the second panel extension to the periphery of the common door inner panel.
